not_found_description: This sticker is not in the album.
locked_description: Spot the {{car}} in real life to stick it in your album.

rarity_explainer.common: Common cars are on every high street. A good first sticker for any page.
rarity_explainer.rare: Rare cars take a sharp eye: think enthusiast car parks and the odd Sunday drive.
rarity_explainer.epic: Epic cars mean a lucky day. Check car meets, dealerships and city centres on a sunny weekend.
rarity_explainer.legendary: Legendary cars are the chase stickers. A handful exist in the whole country, so keep your camera ready.
